result:
The audit is complete. **PR #602**: https://github.com/FChecklist/compliance-tracker/pull/602

**Headline finding: NOT 100% complete.**

- **Phase 4** (defense-in-depth prompt security, PR #562) — **COMPLETE**. Real 4-layer module, 44/44 tests pass, wired into a real production call site. Went through two genuine FAIL→fix→PASS cycles before merging (found via real PR comment history, not assumed) — final PASS quoted in the report.
- **Phase 5** (browser execution, PR #586/#590) — **INCOMPLETE**. 58/58 tests pass and 9 of 13 scope items are genuinely done, but I found the authoritative phase-plan (which doesn't live in this repo — it's in a sibling `claude-control` repo, read read-only) still lists specific undone items: NPU/Built-in-AI tiers are detection-only stubs with no real inference, the general browser storage/sync engines are unbuilt, and the phase's own mandated first step (registering litert-spike) was never done.
- **Phase 8** (DSPy/AI-learning, PR #589) — **INCOMPLETE**. DSPy rejection is well-justified and AI-learning extension is real (27/27 tests pass), but 5 of 7 named engines (translation/localization/marketplace/export/import) are entirely unbuilt — honestly disclosed by the PR's own "increment 1" framing, not hidden.
- **Phase 9** (gateway/knowledge-sync, PR #588) — **COMPLETE against its own explicitly partial scope**.

Also flagged as a cross-cutting gap: the claude-control phase-plan tracker hasn't been updated to reflect any of these 5 merges — it still shows all 4 phases as `not_started`/`blocked`.

All test/tsc numbers were reproduced live this session (2210/2210 pass, tsc clean). Report committed at `ai-os/audits/owner_engine_reaudit_2026-07-27.md`, PR is documentation-only.
